mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi JOIN sku s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND oi.supplier_status = 'READY' AND (oi.tracking_no IS NULL OR oi.tracking_no = '')

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.order_id AS orderId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.option_summary AS optionSummary, oi.supplier_status AS supplierStatus, oi.carrier AS carrier, oi.tracking_no AS trackingNo, oi.created_at AS createdAt FROM order_item oi JOIN sku s ON oi.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND oi.supplier_status = 'READY' AND (oi.tracking_no IS NULL OR oi.tracking_no = '') ORDER BY oi.created_at DESC
